name: csm-copilot-candidate
description: Isolated, bounded real-data candidate snapshot of the CSM Copilot beta.

interface.longDescription: A separate same-account test channel for CSM Copilot. It uses its own plugin identity and private state, and permits only bounded read-only retrieval and private drafts.
defaultPrompt: Check whether CSM Copilot is ready
How many accounts are in my book of business?
Show how my book is distributed by Account Executive and CRM region
Prepare an outreach email and show it here before creating an unsent Gmail draft
Start an invented CSM Copilot beta case
Start with outreach or hand this case to success planning
Show the status and pending approval gate for my beta case
Record my feedback for the completed beta case
